# Embedded storage test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# There is no committed recent per-test duration artifact for these tests
# (engdocs/CI_CLEANUP_PLAN.md records only whole-job wall clock for the
# unsharded storage job, and engdocs/CI_TEST_SURFACE_AUDIT.md does not track
# per-test timing here either). This manifest assigns tests round-robin over
# the alphabetically sorted discovered-test list for the 5-shard CI matrix,
# which spreads adjacent same-prefix families (e.g. the seven
# TestEmbeddedMergeAndSettle* tests and the TestEmbeddedMigration* tests)
# across different shards instead of clustering them in one, as a balance
# heuristic in the absence of timing data. embedded-storage-test-shard.sh
# continues to hash-distribute newly-added tests that are not listed here. TestConformance is deliberately
# excluded — it runs in the separate test-embedded-conformance job, which
# shards by sub-test path (core/audit), not by top-level function name, and
# is a different mechanism from this manifest.
#
# Several tests are placed by measured -race duration instead (PR Risk run
# 36807191489, at the 1000-item issueops.MaxApplyBatchItems cap):
# TestBatchApplyContract (604s) on shard 4, which has ~3m of other tests,
# and TestLargeBatchApplyWallClock_Embedded (261s) on shard 5. Hashed,
# TestBatchApplyContract shared shard 2 with ~5m of other tests and ran it
# past the job's old 15m timeout; placed so, the heaviest shard projects to
# ~13m.
#
# TestLargeBatchApplyStatementCounts_Embedded (247s in that same run) was
# later split into TestLargeBatchApplyStatementCounts356_Embedded,
# TestLargeBatchApplyStatementCounts712_Embedded and
# TestLargeBatchApplyStatementCountsClassic40_Embedded (slice F1, CI shard
# balance; see internal/storage/embeddeddolt/large_batch_apply_measure_test.go).
# All 3 are kept on shard 2, where the single test used to live, rather than
# rebalanced across this frozen 5-shard block.

# Embedded-Dolt storage test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# 20-shard split for the Bazel-only embedded-Dolt storage tier
# (bazel-embedded in .github/workflows/bazel.yml), bin-packed
# longest-processing-time-first by measured wall-time from
# scripts/ci/embedded_storage_test_durations.json (see that file for provenance
# and its "relative weight, not absolute SLA" caveat).
# Regenerate with scripts/ci/gen_embedded_storage_shard_manifest.py 20
# --weights=duration --write after adding or removing Test* functions in
# internal/storage/embeddeddolt/*_test.go. --write is incremental: it
# keeps every already-assigned test on its current shard and only places
# newly-discovered names, onto whichever shard is currently lightest, so
# two unrelated PRs that each add one test do not textually conflict or
# silently invalidate each other's packing. Pass --repack to force a full
# from-scratch rebalance instead (a deliberate, separate change — expect a
# large diff). --check only verifies every discovered name is listed here
# exactly once (no stale or duplicate entries); it does NOT verify the
# packing is still well-balanced.
#
# This file is generated: notes added here are erased by the next
# regeneration. Add them to the generator or the durations file instead.
